problem: The caption says the writer makes 65 writes, but the spec shows 'write 1000 B' followed by '65 more writes', which is 66 writes. The 66th write is the one that blocks, so the spec and caption disagree by one write.
fix: Change the spec label to '64 more writes', so the diagram totals 65 successful writes and then the block on write 66.

problem: 'When it is empty the reader blocks' is incomplete. A read on an empty pipe returns end-of-file (0 bytes) if no process holds the write end open; it blocks only while some writer still has the pipe open. As written, a student may think the reader blocks forever after the writer closes.
fix: Say: while at least one writer holds the write end open, an empty pipe blocks the reader; if all write ends are closed, a read returns 0 bytes, meaning end-of-file.
